newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: One man dies in Lithuania prison riot.
newsitem.headline: One man dies in Lithuania prison riot.

text.p: One man was killed after around 300 inmates of a prison in the Baltic state of Lithuania rioted in the early hours of Thursday, the interior ministry said.
The man died of gunshot wounds on his way to hospital after the riot broke out in the Pravieniskes prison some 70 kms (44 miles) to the west of capital Vilnius, a spokeswoman said.
She said the prisoners were armed with wooden batons and stones and seized control of a part of the prison. They smashed windows and fencing but none of the prison staff was injured.
The riot was finally subdued with the help of interior ministry troops.
"They have done a check and none of the prisoners escaped," the spokeswoman said.
